name: data-vector-databases
description: Use when the user asks to pick an index type for vector similarity search, pgvector, Qdrant, Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate, HNSW vs IVF vs PQ, metadata filtering or storing embeddings. Produces vector store choice, collection schema and ANN index settings for recall, latency and memory. Not for full RAG pipeline design (use llm-rag-retrieval-internals).
